page.notes: Catchword "apud" is at the lower right, below the last line. The text is one continuous paragraph of references, with no indents on this page. The first line continues from the previous page. Printed hyphens kept: "Tyran-nide", "Reno-uato", "tem-pore", "aduersa-riorum", "credulita-tem", "fum-mis" (joined). "pertur-bato" has no visible hyphen at the line end, so it is written whole. "cotra" is read as "cōtra" from its tilde. "geredę" is doubtful (the ę is printed; the word may be "gerēdę"). "exilij" and "Pompeij" are written with final ii per the rule for vowel i. The right edge of the scan is cut off, so the last words of the lines there may be incomplete.
